answer: The karst edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 122 clones produces a signature the comet analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Someone must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the wharf settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 20 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
